about: Spellbook name, tooltip and icon of every custom class spell in the /spells picker. tools/client_spell_sync.py writes them into the client Spell.dbc carriers and the picker labels; each text states the behaviour after the 2026-10-08 rework (share-public custom-spells/08-rework-20261008.md). icon_spell = the stock spell whose SpellIconID the record shows (absent: keep the record's icon).

entries.description: Casting Starfall while it is active stacks it, up to 10 times: each stack calls down its own stars.

entries.name: Lunar Frenzy
entries.description: In Moonkin Form every killing blow grants Lunar Frenzy for 60 sec: +1% damage and casting speed, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks you cast a free instant Starfire at a random enemy in front of you every 3 sec while in combat.

entries.name: Swipe (Bear): Bleed
entries.description: Your Swipe in Bear Form makes every enemy it hits bleed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Maul: Bleeding Wounds
entries.description: Your Maul deals 50% more damage to bleeding targets.

entries.name: Swipe (Bear): +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Swipe in Bear Form by 50%.

entries.name: Thorns: Open Wounds
entries.description: When your Thorns damages a bleeding enemy, its wound opens: you deal Physical damage to it that increases with your Paragon level and ignores armor. Can occur once every 5 sec per enemy.

entries.name: Ursine Bulwark
entries.description: Each hit you take in Bear Form grants Ursine Bulwark for 30 sec: +1% maximum health, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks Barkskin stays active on you, and every 100 Rage you spend sends out a quake that deals Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards; the damage increases with your Paragon level.

entries.name: Swipe (Cat): Bleed
entries.description: Your Swipe in Cat Form makes every enemy it hits bleed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Energy: +50% Regeneration
entries.description: Increases your Energy regeneration by 50%.

entries.name: Swipe (Cat): +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Swipe in Cat Form by 50%.

entries.name: Frontal Assault
entries.description: You can use Shred and Ravage from any direction, not only from behind the target.

entries.name: Berserk: Unleashed
entries.description: While Berserk is active your movement speed is increased by 100%, and every finisher you use with 5 combo points unleashes a blow that deals Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards. The damage increases with your Paragon level.

entries.name: Treant Call
entries.description: Your heal-over-time effects have a 5% chance on each tick to call a Healing Treant to fight for you for 30 sec. Can occur once every 5 sec.

entries.name: Summons: Healing Power
entries.description: Your summons gain 10 health for every point of your healing power.

entries.name: Summons: Parting Bloom
entries.description: When one of your summons dies or its time runs out, it heals all allies within 10 yards.

entries.name: Thorns: Rejuvenation
entries.description: When an enemy strikes a target protected by your Thorns, there is a 20% chance you cast Rejuvenation on that target. Can occur once every 3 sec per target.

entries.name: Heal over Time: +50%
entries.description: Increases the periodic healing of your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom and Wild Growth by 50%.

entries.name: Heal over Time: Double Speed
entries.description: Your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom and Wild Growth tick twice as fast and last twice as long.

entries.name: Deep Reserves
entries.description: Your mana regeneration is increased by 2% for every 1% of mana you are missing.

entries.name: Killing Blow: Recovery
entries.description: Killing an enemy heals you for 5% of your maximum health.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: Your melee attacks have a 25% chance to grant you an extra attack. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Cleaving Strikes
entries.description: Your attacks, shots and harmful spells have a 10% chance to deal their damage to all other enemies within 10 yards of the target as well. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.description: When you avoid an attack - a miss, dodge, parry or block - you counter-attack for 50% of your attack power. Can occur once every 2 sec.

entries.name: Empowered
entries.description: Increases all damage you deal by 5%.
